title: APAC compact-sku reservations launch playbook & release coordination
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Launch coordination for two new Dedicated SKUs tailored for APAC: a low-cost 'compact' instance family (compact-x1) and an updated higher-throughput instance (compact-x1-pro) in Singapore and Tokyo regions, plus a three-tier reservation product (monthly-flex / 1yr-commit / 3yr-commit). This ticket centralizes GTM artifacts, release notes sequencing, cross-team tasks, and the cutover plan for existing reservation customers who opt to migrate. Goal: enable public availability and pricing/page + Console SKU creation, ensure Sales and Support kits are ready, and ship coordinated release notes and migration docs.
acceptance_criteria: Console SKU pages and buy flow show compact-x1 and compact-x1-pro with correct pricing and reservation options
Backend capacity and autoscaling policies validated in both ap-southeast-1 (SG) and ap-northeast-1 (TYO) in staging
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal/Compliance, and scheduled with release-2026.04 notes
Sales enablement pack published with migration worksheet and pricing calculator
Customer-facing migration self-serve guide + support runbook published
Telemetry: token-level cost, latency p95, reservation utilization metrics instrumented in Console dashboards
tasks: Finalize SKU naming & unit economics (PM + Pricing) - target 2026-03-05
Engineering: capacity placement, node sizing, and kernel tuning for compact family - ENG-6122
Infra: create SG/TYO instance types, VPC network templates, and zone quotas
Console: add product pages, reservation purchase flow, and billing integration
Legal: update TOS addendum for reserved capacity and data residency language
Sales & Solutions: prepare playbook, price sheets, and migration checklist
Docs: draft release notes, migration guide, FAQ, and runbooks
Support: train L2 team, create triage runbook and escalation matrix
Telemetry: add reservation utilization panel and outage alert thresholds
QA: run end-to-end purchase/cancel/refund flows and upgrade/downgrade scenarios
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Kapoor: Kickoff completed. Working group formed: ENG (Lucas, Priya), Infra (Marco), Console (Tina), Legal (Sook-Ja), Sales (Diego). Decided tentative GA target: 2026-04-06.

2026-03-04 - Lucas Nguyen: Cluster sizing experiments show 18% better throughput per GPU on compact-x1-pro for short-context workloads; opens possibility to slightly tighten price for pro tier. Need kernel tuning PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8743

2026-03-06 - Priya Iyer (ENG): Discovered a KV-cache fragmentation edge-case under continuous batching at small sequence lengths. Mitigation: disable prefix compaction for compact family for initial launch. Cost/latency trade-off documented in design note (Drive link).
2026-03-08 - Tina Morales (Console): Console UX mocks reviewed. PM feedback: show estimated monthly cost post-reservation on SKU page. Working on pricing calculator component (Figma link).

2026-03-09 - Legal (Sook-Ja): Need explicit clause for reservation migration cooling-off period. Adding to release notes and checkout T&Cs. Impact: cannot auto-migrate customers before 30 days post-GA.
2026-03-11 - Sales (Diego): Partner pilot with CloudPartner APAC agreed. Will announce to 5 pilot customers on 2026-03-20. Request for a migration spreadsheet template from PM.
2026-03-12 - Lucas Nguyen: Canaries show stable p95 under expected pilot load. Open items: billing rounding bug (#HRT-2227) and multi-commit discount calculation in billing microservice.
2026-03-13 - Aisha Kapoor: Draft release notes completed and uploaded. Waiting Legal sign-off and final pricing table. Next: schedule release notes publication and coordinate Console deploy window.
decisions: Ship compact-x1 family without quantized-specialized variant on GA. Rationale: quantized variant adds operational complexity and delays; plan to add in a follow-up release after telemetry collection.
Enable migration opt-in only; no forced auto-migrations for existing reservation customers (Legal requirement).
Reserve a 10% headroom in SG region for burst capacity during first 30 days post-GA to reduce risk of throttling.
Discounting: 1yr-commit = 18% off list, 3yr-commit = 30% off; flex-monthly = no discount but lower up-front commitment. Pricing finalized 2026-03-05.
rollout_checklist: Week -3: Pilot invitations sent to partner customers and early access cohort
Week -2: Engineering canary deploy in ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1; QA full smoke
Week -1: Legal sign-off on release notes & checkout T&Cs; Console dry-run deploy
GA day: Public docs + release notes published, Console SKUs enabled, Marketing announcement sent
GA +30d: Review telemetry for latency p95, reservation utilization, and support ticket volume; decide on quantized variant roadmap

Legal to finalize migration cooling-off text by 2026-03-15
Console team to land pricing calculator component (PR #8891) by 2026-03-18
Schedule cross-functional release runbook rehearsal on 2026-03-24
Publish Sales enablement kit and worksheet by 2026-03-19
notes: This ticket is the single source-of-truth for the compact SKU APAC launch. Keep updates concise and include links to artifacts. Major scope changes must be approved by Head of PM. Track customer pilot feedback in the Sales channel (#sales-apac-compact) and tag Support incidents with 'compact-sku' label.
